name: FPP Pushover Notifications
author: Juan Melendrez
description: Tracks RemoteFalcon song selections and main show start/end events, with configurable event settings, local Pushover credentials, a test-notification tool, a dashboard, and duplicate-suppressed event tracking.

privacy.summary: The plugin stores local notification preferences, Pushover credentials, and detected RemoteFalcon song selections and main show start/end events. The configuration page can send a test notification to Pushover. When RemoteFalcon song notifications are enabled and credentials are configured, detected RemoteFalcon song selections are sent to Pushover automatically.

sends.what: Test notification message and Pushover authentication credentials
sends.when: When the operator clicks Send Test Notification, and automatically when an enabled RemoteFalcon song selection is detected
sends.purpose: Verify Pushover credentials and HTTPS connectivity, and notify the operator of RemoteFalcon song selections

collects.what: Local event history and notification preferences
Pushover User Key and API Token

privacy.other: Pushover credentials are stored in the local FPP plugin configuration file and are not displayed back in the web interface. The test action sends an HTTPS request to api.pushover.net. Enabled RemoteFalcon song selections also send HTTPS notifications to api.pushover.net. Show start/end events remain local-only.
